title: Rafi and Plum Make Green
markdown:
The sun peeked through Rafi’s window. Stripes! Rafi knew today was special. Discovery Day at Science Club was tomorrow. He felt a fluttery excitement. He dashed outside. Plum the rabbit hopped by, her tail bobbing.

“Plum!” Rafi called. “We need to paint the banner!” Plum twitched her nose. Yes! They scampered to the science shed. It smelled like experiments and cookies. Mr. Reed hummed. The big white banner lay ready.

Rafi grabbed red paint. Plum nudged yellow. Perfect! “Now,” Rafi chirped, reaching for blue, “we need sky and birds!” But the blue pot was empty. “Oh, no!” he gasped. Plum squeaked.

Mr. Reed peeked. “Oh dear,” he murmured. “Not much blue paint left.”

Rafi’s mind whirred. Red and yellow made orange. What about yellow and blue? He spotted blue chalk dust. “Look!” he exclaimed. “The chalk made water blue-ish!”

Mr. Reed smiled. “Great idea, Rafi! Let’s be brave and try!”

Rafi and Plum looked at each other, eyes shining. They put yellow paint on a palette. Then a tiny bit of blue, just a dab from the last smear in the pot. Slowly a vibrant green swirled, like grass waking up. Rafi felt the smooth paint under his brush. He saw the amazing green bloom. “It’s green!” Plum squeaked, hopping. “Like grass!”

Rafi giggled. “It worked! We can make colours!” With Mr. Reed’s help they mixed more yellow and blue for green trees along the bottom of the banner. Then they stirred red and a last whisper of blue until a deep purple sky appeared, ready for twinkling stars.

They painted streaks of green and purple. A red sun! Yellow flowers! The banner looked spectacular, as if the shed itself had grown a meadow overnight.

Rafi beamed. “We didn’t need more blue!”

Plum nodded. “We made our own green and purple!”

Rafi and Plum looked at their banner, then at each other. Their minds buzzed with questions. What other secrets were waiting on the palette? The adventure of discovery was just beginning.
characters: Rafi (a fluttery-excited question asker), Plum (a bobbing-tailed rabbit), Reed (a humming science-shed teacher)
author: StoryGen Community
